title: Connectivity - DMG MORI
text: Connectivity - DMG MORI Home Products Digitization Connectivity for all Machines Secure Machine Connectivity With Connectivity powered by DMG MORI, we offer secure networking of all new DMG MORI machines from 2020 as standard, existing DMG MORI machines and machines from third-party manufacturers. The machine data, availability status, productivity indicators, process data and any additional machine signals can be made available to the user applications via the common standard protocols OPC-UA, MTconnect and MQTT. With the IoT connector , connectivity is supplied as standard with every new DMG MORI machine. The IoT connector retrofit ist the solution for existing DMG MORI machines that are up to 10 years old and the IoT connector flex enables the networking of third-party machines and peripheral devices. IoTconnector IoTconnector retrofit IoTconnector flex As standard in all new DMG MORI machines Contains: IoT connector or CELOS X Edge (HW) MachineDataConnector (SW) NET service (SW) Additional software options Messenger V4 TULIP Pro Plan 5 Extension options WIFI modules 4G / LTE modules 5 Applies up to 10 machines Retrofitting of DMG MORI machines from approx. 2013 When retrofitting existing DMG MORI machines from 2013 onwards, the “Digital Manufacturing Package” offers the ideal start to connectivity and digitalization. The Digital Manufacturing Package includes: IoTconnector retrofit (hardware) : Secure machine connection Machine data connector (software) : Machine data standardization of different CNC controls NETservice (software) : Remote maintenance by DMG MORI Service Messenger V4 (software) : Machine monitoring shows the status of connected machines CELOS Update 2 (software) : Update of every existing CELOS version since 2013 my DMG MORI - customer portal: End-to-end service optimization for DMG MORI machines DMG MORI retrofit before 2013 & 3rd party Contains: IoTc onnector flex MachineDataConnector (SW) Updates / Remote support for 24 month Additional software options Messenger V4 TULIP Pro Plan 5 Extension options None Installation Via DMG MORI Service Via Customer 5 Applies to up to 10 machines FAQ What is Connectivity from DMG MORI? Connectivity from DMG MORI is a product group that includes all products to connect machines and devices in the production of our customers. This includes the hardware (IoT connector , IoTconnector retrofit & IoTc onnector flex ) including the software for the machine data interface and our remote service solution NET service . Which machines can be connected with DMG MORI's connectivity? All DMG MORI machines and even third-party machines. Who installs connectivity from DMG MORI in my company? Either the regional DMG MORI Service or you yourself, provided you have a company electrician. What are the advantages of Connectivity from DMG MORI compared to other market solutions? Our solution is compatible with DMG MORI machines and third-party products and can be used directly with the Messenger or TULIP. The OPC UA interface is included in all solutions (also for machines with Heidenhain) Connectivity from DMG MORI is a product and not a project. The customer buys standardized and preconfigured products that can be installed by DMG MORI Service. The customer is supported by DMG MORI in all questions relating to connectivity. How long does the installation take per machine? It takes between one and three hours per machine. The machine downtime is limited to a few minutes! How do I get a suitable offer for connectivity? Talk to your DMG MORI Area Sales Manager. The responsible DMG MORI Service Sales Manager will work with you to qualify the machines to be connected and, after technical clarification, will provide you with a quotation. What are DMG MORI software applications that I can use in combination with can use in combination with connectivity? The Messenger and TULIP can be used directly. change "> CELOS X change Networking the entire production environment in CELOS X The data made available by „Connectivity powered by DMG MORI“ is the foundation of a consistent user experience in data based applications and at the same time it provides the base for well-informed decisions. With the help of end-to-end connectivity, the data management of CELOS X change - the control center of the digital and data-based ecosystem CELOS X – impresses with a reliable infrastructure and ensures manufacturer-independent networking of the entire production environment. As a cloud-based data hub, CELOS X change enables the open, secure and bidirectional data transfer from the entire production process to the company’s IT and, in the future, with external partners along the supply chain and within global supply networks. Use Cases Connectivity created the basis for data-related added value. No data without connectivity. No applications without data. Without applications, no data-based optimizations. Machine data that is collected during machine operation and made available via connectivity is used in a wide range of applications. Connectivity data, powered by CELOS X change , is used in some CELOS X perience applications, for example. Remote Machine Maintenance Condition Monitoring Remote Machine Maintenance Machines can be remotely monitored, diagnosed and repaired using real-time connectivity without the need for a service technician to be on site in person. This reduces service times and costs. DMG MORI Application: NET service Condition Monitoring By permanently monitoring machine performance in real time, unexpected failures can be detected immediately and action taken. This reduces downtimes and increases productivity.
